input.quote: 8.1 By Commerce One. Commerce One shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio and its Customers from any and all damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) incurred by Corio or its Customers arising out of any claim that the Software infringes any patent, copyright, trademark or trade right secret of a third party
input.rationale: Section 8.1 gives us a Commerce One IP infringement indemnity with defence, notice/control/cooperation procedure and procure/modify/refund remedies, and Section 9 expressly carves Section 8 out of the liability cap, so the fallback is met and there is no reciprocal indemnity from us to narrow. However, the preferred position also requires Vendor indemnities for breach of applicable law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of our (and our Customers') data, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct; those limbs are absent, so we inserted a new Section 8.3 carrying them and applying the existing Section 8.1 procedure while confirming the IP-specific exclusions in 8.2 do not apply.

proposal.summary: Add Commerce One indemnity limbs for breach of law, data/Confidential Information breach, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 8 gives us Commerce One's IP infringement indemnity but nothing for Commerce One's breach of law, unauthorized disclosure of our or our Customers' data, or its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, so we have added those limbs (using the same notice, control and cooperation procedure) as required by our indemnity position. If Commerce One prefers, we can accept the IP indemnity alone only where its indemnity obligations are backed by a super-cap of 3x annual fees.

ops.text: 8.3 Additional Indemnities. Commerce One shall further indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio, its affiliates and its Customers from and against any and all third-party claims, and all resulting damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) Commerce One's breach of applicable law; (ii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Corio's or its Customers' data or Confidential Information caused by Commerce One; or (iii) Commerce One's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The notice, control and cooperation procedures set forth in Section 8.1 shall apply to any claim under this Section 8.3, and the limitations set forth in Section 8.2 shall not apply to this Section 8.3.
